item.title: Former Cactus City employee pleads guilty to stealing $88,745 from the city
item.description: CACTUS, Texas (KAMR/KCIT) — Following an investigation by the Texas Rangers, a former Court Clerk for the City of Cactus Municipal Court pleaded guilty to stealing $88,745 from the city. item.description: Incumbent John Cornyn and challenger Wesley Hunt are ramping up their campaigns for the U.S. Senate race in Texas, with Cornyn discussing his age, relationship with President Trump, and plans to win the runoff if he makes it, while Hunt is attacking Cornyn's record.

item.title: Impact the H-1B visa freeze could have on educational institutions
item.description: As we previously reported, Governor Greg Abbott announced an investigation into the H-1B visa program. This leads to public institutions of higher education freezing all applications until May 2027.
